stories.title: The 'Layer King': How 49ers QB Brock Purdy mastered one of the hardest throws in football
stories.summary: Purdy is terrific at layering the football -- fitting it perfectly between the second and third levels of the defense. And it's a big reason why he's playing at an MVP level this season.

stories.title: 'Want to apologize to my wife for this': Inside Washington's wild week after Giants tie
stories.summary: Questions swirl Washington following last Sunday's embarrassing tie with the Giants. Where will they go from here?

stories.title: Banged-up Rams lose star WR Adams for 6-10 weeks, McVay says
stories.summary: Rams wideout Davante Adams ruptured a hamstring in Sunday's loss to the Cardinals, and he will be sidelined for six to 10 weeks, coach Sean McVay announced.

stories.title: Sources: Hurts to miss season after blood clots discovered in QB's lungs
stories.summary: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season after doctors discovered multiple blood clots in his lungs, according to NFL Network and ESPN.

stories.title: Stephen Jones: Schottenheimer has full support of Cowboys' ownership
stories.summary: Brian Schottenheimer has the full support of Cowboys ownership, Stephen Jones said Monday on 105.3 The Fan in Dallas.
